summary: Restore verification now requires manifest.createdAt to use the canonical UTC ISO-8601 millisecond representation emitted by backup creation; parseable offset and date-only timestamps fail closed before a restore destination is created.
limitations: This proves local manifest timestamp canonicalization and fail-closed restore admission only; it does not establish trusted time provenance or external signing.
This local qualification does not claim independent review, off-host retention, staging mutation, or production rollback evidence.
